name: SHEPHERD
canonical: an ancient Near-Eastern shepherd, a sturdy Hebrew herdsman of about forty with sun-darkened olive skin and a dark weather-worn beard, kind watchful eyes, wrapped in a rough undyed cream goat-hair cloak over a coarse brown girded tunic and a simple head-cloth, a worn leather sling at his belt, standing watchful among his flock with a tall crooked staff in hand
first_used: 07 I AM the Door — The Shepherd Who Became the Gate
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
